title: Roles & Permissions is hidden for users without the App Settings sub-toggle
custom_preconds: 1. A user is assigned a role with Settings off, or Settings on but the App Settings sub-toggle off.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Look at the left sidebar.
custom_expected: Either the Settings area does not appear, or the Roles & Permissions item is not shown under it.
evidence: UI: a role with a Settings sub-toggle but WITHOUT App Settings (ZZAUTOTEST SetFin = settingsFinance only, round 6) shows a Settings area with only its Finance items (Payment Methods, Taxes) and NO Roles & Permissions / Staff entries — Roles & Permissions is hidden for users without the App Settings sub-toggle. screenshot settings-SetFin.
